events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in 1960s counterculture, began on this day in 1969 in Bethel, New York, drawing nearly half a million people.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and magic. What's your top Woodstock memory or performance?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977, and would have been 91.

angles.name: King Forever
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost the King. His music still moves millions. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas in 1996, and would have been 55.

angles.name: Hip Hop Legend
angles.copy: 30 years since the music world lost Tupac. His influence remains undeniable. Which track is still on your playlist?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, and would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His guitar work still sounds out of this world.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Crossing
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Rebel
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, still commanding the stage.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad Fer It
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: 'Imagine' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: 55 years of John Lennon's 'Imagine'. A powerful album with a message that resonates as strongly today as it did then.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed how we listen to music forever. What was the first album you loaded on yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who's your favourite 007 and what's the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedic legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: 'The White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in the UK on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Double Album Delight
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. Which track is your hidden gem?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991, and would have been 80.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
